final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS trade_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tr.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(trade_count) AS overall_count, AVG(trade_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(tc.trade_count) AS combined_count, AVG(1.0 * tc.trade_count / t.overall_count) AS average_share, AVG(tc.trade_count - t.average_count) AS average_amount_above_count FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE tc.trade_count > t.average_count
